content:
Let \(y_n=f(x+2n)\). The recurrence becomes
\[
y_{n+1}+y_{n-1}=y_n,
\]
with characteristic equation
\[
r^2-r+1=0.
\]
Its roots are
\[
r=e^{\pm i\pi/3},
\]
which satisfy \(r^6=1\). Hence \(y_{n+6}=y_n\) for all \(n\), so
\[
f(x+2(n+6))=f(x+2n).
\]
Letting \(t=x+2n\), this gives
\[
f(t+12)=f(t).
\]
Thus one period is \(12\).

\[
\boxed{12}
\]
